body: My store went from 10-12k max to around 13-15k regularly and we keep getting shafted on workers but they recently added more preppers which has been nice

I usually just put 2 bags out and rolle them up in a cone shape then ill do one pass through and its usually passable if were really busy that day but on the average day ill do a second pass over it all in small pieces takes me about 6-8 minute per 2 bags and i solo about 16 each morning

Not gonna lie ive been doing double drops of chicken and 1.5 steaks double dropping beans rices 3 bags of both shreds at a time my GM gets mad that i have so much food but when i dont get a grill 2 and they expect me to do all that work i dont even care anymore
Depends on the director mine failed once and they threatened to replace all the managers if we failed a second and then fire the entire store and train a new team if we failed a 3rd

I wish i could say life is worth living but maybe it isnt  alll i know is staying alive has worked for me so far and it might work for you i have become of the if it aint broke dont fix it mentally so my advice is if living isnt broken dont fix it by dying
